record.title: Endless mode ending screen can be skipped after death
record.description:
When the endless mode is over, players can still try to match items with urgency but as soon as the level is over, the ending screen is visible.

However that screen has no input blocker whatsoever. So it might be skipped at once while trying to match objects. 

Here is the expected outcome:

* When the level ends, block the input until the x2 multiplication happens. So that players won't skip it accidentally. 

[[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6336].8623973.mp4]([URL_52789])

record.title: Orphan items in boss arena
record.description:
After refills, sometimes objects are not spawned as sets 3 items. It happens along with refill. The objects should be spawned as sets no matter what. 

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6362]_1.MP4]([URL_52871])

**Expected behavior is to refill objects by 3 items (1 set) not one by one so the orphan items can be fixed.**

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6361]_1.MP4]([URL_52870])

Expected behavior is to refill objects by 3 items (1 set) not one by one so the orphan items can be fixed.
